query:
SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name, ss.sessionId AS session_id, ss.absent, ss.role,
       ses.problemNumber AS problem_number, ses.sessionNumber AS session_number, ses.status
FROM students s
JOIN session_students ss ON ss.studentId = s.id
JOIN sessions ses ON ses.id = ss.sessionId
WHERE s.name LIKE '%Luana%'
ORDER BY ses.problemNumber, ses.sessionNumber;
